name: Skill
description: Base skill type - all skills fall under this category

name: Attack Skill
description: Skills that are attacks

name: Melee Attack
description: Close-range attack skills

name: Pet Attack
description: Attack skills used by pets

name: Axe Attack
description: Attack skills that require an axe

name: Dagger Attack
description: Attack skills that require daggers

name: Lead Attack
description: Dagger attacks that must be used first in a chain

name: Off-Hand Attack
description: Dagger attacks that must follow a lead attack

name: Dual Attack
description: Dagger attacks that can be used after off-hand attacks

name: Hammer Attack
description: Attack skills that require a hammer

name: Scythe Attack
description: Attack skills that require a scythe

name: Sword Attack
description: Attack skills that require a sword

name: Ranged Attack
description: Long-range attack skills

name: Bow Attack
description: Attack skills that require a bow

name: Spear Attack
description: Attack skills that require a spear

name: Blessing
description: Powerful beneficial effects granted by avatars

name: Chant
description: Songs or chants that affect allies

name: Condition
description: Negative status effects

name: Disguise
description: Skills that change the appearance of the character

name: Echo
description: Skills that copy other skills

name: Elite Skill
description: Powerful skills - only one can be equipped at a time

name: Environment Effect
description: Effects caused by the environment

name: Form
description: Skills that transform the character

name: Glyph
description: Skills that modify the next spell cast

name: Party Bonus
description: Bonuses that affect the entire party

name: Preparation
description: Skills that modify arrows or attacks

name: Ritual
description: Skills that create spirits or ritual effects

name: Binding Ritual
description: Rituals that create spirits bound to a location

name: Nature Ritual
description: Rituals that create nature spirits

name: Ebon Vanguard Ritual
description: Special rituals associated with the Ebon Vanguard

name: Shout
description: Vocal skills that affect allies or foes

name: Signet
description: No-cost skills that can be used without energy

name: Spell
description: Magic-based skills that can be cast

name: Enchantment Spell
description: Spells that provide beneficial effects over time

name: Flash Enchantment Spell
description: Enchantments that trigger immediately when ending

name: Hex Spell
description: Spells that inflict negative effects over time

name: Item Spell
description: Spells that create items

name: Ward Spell
description: Spells that create protective areas

name: Weapon Spell
description: Spells that affect weapons

name: Well Spell
description: Spells that create wells at corpse locations

name: Stance
description: Combat postures that provide benefits

name: Title
description: Skills granted by titles

name: Touch Skill
description: Skills that require touching the target

name: Trap
description: Skills that create traps on the ground
